title: Listening Drill — Loan bicycle
description: Customer service dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Loan bicycle
sections.transcript:
CUSTOMER: I need some help with a bicycle from the loan scheme. The main problem is loose pedals. I thought I could solve it myself, but the instructions don't cover what I've seen.

ADVISER: We can look into it. First please send the hire receipt. Then bring the item to the repair workshop. If you go to the original collection point they will send you back here.

CUSTOMER: What happens if you can't sort it out while I'm there?

ADVISER: Ask for a backup bicycle. please walk it to the workshop. Keep the confirmation until the issue has been closed.
